name: Crash Bandicoot Kled
creator: czcz
description:
### CRASH BANDICOOT FROM WRAITH OF CORTEX AS KLED
Kled is reimagined as Crash Bandicoot, riding the hulking mech suit from Wrath of Cortex instead of Skaarl. The skin blends chaotic cartoon energy with oversized industrial sci-fi machinery, turning Kled into a manic marsupial warlord piloting a barely-stable experimental titan.

Crash keeps his wild personality intact — spinning, shouting gibberish, and taunting enemies with exaggerated animations — while the mech stomps through the Rift with heavy hydraulic movement, glowing Cortex-tech energy, and explosive cartoon physics.

The skin would fit perfectly as a Legendary-tier experience, featuring:

Full new voice lines
Custom model and rig
New VFX/SFX
New animations
Dynamic mount/rider interactions
